title: Founder, Data Centre Buildout
description:
Forum's Venture Studio brings together ambitious people, brilliant ideas, and capital to build the best B2B SaaS businesses in the world, from 0 to 1. In addition to capital and an idea, we provide founders with access to investor networks, fundraising support, and the resources needed to build transformational companies. Our AI Studio has launched 17 companies since 2023, and we're launching 7 more in 2026. We're designed to help Founders move faster, develop better insights, and build companies that have a higher success rate than startups built in any other way.

**We are seeking Founders/CEOs to launch and run future companies.** As CEO, you’ll be leading the charge with a CTO, Designer, GTM and validation experts by your side until your own team is hired. You’ll also have the support of recruitment, HR, legal, finance, and more to scale.

**What We’re Looking At:**

The AI buildout got its chips and its capital. It didn’t get the industrial economy underneath it. Transformers, switchgear and turbines are sold out for years, and the factories that make them face their own fight over sites, power, permits and working capital. Engineered equipment is sourced, qualified and moved by phone calls and spreadsheets. Sites get built faster than they get powered. Trillions in debt and equity are flowing into projects, equipment and factories that nobody has the data to underwrite. Every link in the chain is a bottleneck, and the companies that clear them become the backbone of a new economy. Forum AI Studio is looking for a Founder exploring any of these themes:

* Factory buildouts: readiness, capital and coordination for manufacturers standing up production capacity
* Engineering supply chain: procurement and expediting, substitution and qualification, recertified equipment, and heavy-haul logistics
* Power readiness, behind-the-meter development, interconnection and permitting for data center projects

title: Electrical Project Manager
description: Location: 99 Hawley Lane, Suite 401, Stratford, CT 06614 Work arrangement: In person strongly preferred, hybrid arrangements considered. Travel: Occasional travel required Reports to: Head of EV Operations Compensation: $120,000 to $165,000 base salary, depending on experience, plus a 5% to 10% annual performance bonus Benefits: Health insurance and 401(k) About Lionheart Energy Lionheart Energy helps businesses and property owners reduce energy use and costs through energy-efficiency upgrades, including HVAC systems, insulation, windows, and building controls. We also install clean energy solutions, including electric vehicle (EV) chargers and battery energy storage systems (BESS). With our own construction and electrical teams, we deliver projects across Connecticut, New Jersey, Massachusetts, and Rhode Island. The Opportunity We are seeking an Electrical Project Manager to run our EV charger and electrical projects from start to finish across multiple states. Reporting to the Head of EV Operations, the Electrical Project Manager will build, hire, and lead electrical teams in each market. The Electrical Project Manager will manage materials and inventory and deliver every project on time, on budget, and to code. Key responsibilities **Manage EV charger and electrical projects from start to finish, from bid and planning through installation, inventory, and closeout, including scope, schedule, budget, quality, and safety.**  Build new electrical teams as the company grows, including recruiting and hiring electricians, foremen, and crews in new markets. **Manage electrical teams in multiple states at the same time, with consistent standards, scheduling, and accountability.**  Plan and manage electrical materials, EV charging equipment, supplies, and inventory for every project.
